question: What are the official working hours for GESCI staff?
notes: chunk_107 (Page 32) contains section 5.1 Hours of Work: 9am-5:30pm Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week

question: Are flexible working hours a guaranteed right for employees?
notes: chunk_107 explains flexible hours can be agreed; chunk_108 explicitly states they are NOT a guaranteed right

question: What is the annual leave entitlement for full-time staff?
notes: chunk_108 (Page 32) states 24 days per annum; chunk_109 explains it accrues at 2 days per month

question: How many days of sick leave is a staff member entitled to?
notes: chunk_117 defines sick leave eligibility; chunk_118 specifies 2 days per month (1 full pay, 1 half pay), max 3 months full + 3 months half

question: What is the probationary period for new staff members?
notes: chunk_67 (Page 21) section 3.6.1: probation is six months for contracts exceeding 12 months, extendable by another six months

question: How long is the maternity leave entitlement?
notes: chunk_124 (Page 37) states 16 weeks maternity leave; chunk_125 provides additional conditions including full pay

question: How many weeks notice must a staff member give when resigning?
notes: chunk_227 (Page 69) section 10.1: four weeks written notice, or one week if still on probation

question: Can a staff member take uncertified sick leave, and for how many days?
notes: chunk_119 (Page 35): up to 7 working days uncertified sick leave per year, max 3 consecutive days at once

question: What happens if a staff member is recalled from annual leave?
notes: chunk_110 (Page 33): remaining leave must be taken as early as possible in same year or carried forward

question: What is the paternity leave entitlement?
notes: chunk_126 (Page 37): two weeks paternity leave with full pay, can be taken continuously or in separate periods within one year of birth
